title: Spring bookings point to a slow Orvan recovery

facts.subject: Orvan wheat
facts.statement: Grain buyers in Midgard are booking more Orvan wheat for the spring, though volumes remain far below the levels before the corridor ended.

source_ref.text_snippet: Grain buyers in Midgard are booking more Orvan wheat for the spring, though volumes remain far below the levels before the corridor ended.

facts.subject: Orvan ports
facts.statement: Port agents in Orvan say berth use is improving from the winter low.

source_ref.text_snippet: Port agents in Orvan say berth use is improving from the winter low.

facts.subject: Rail loadings
facts.statement: Rail loadings through Ravik are still high, and Vanir continues to supply part of Midgard's wheat.

source_ref.text_snippet: Rail loadings through Ravik are still high, and Vanir continues to supply part of Midgard's wheat.

facts.subject: Midgard wheat purchases
facts.statement: The bookings are still small compared with the trade before the corridor ended, and buyers are careful not to commit to large volumes.

source_ref.text_snippet: The bookings are still small compared with the trade before the corridor ended, and buyers are careful not to commit to large volumes.

validation_notes: Citation repaired: quote found in ¶6, not cited ¶5

facts.subject: Port index and rail timetable
facts.statement: Buyers say they are watching the port index and the rail timetable before they commit to larger contracts.

source_ref.text_snippet: Buyers say they are watching the port index and the rail timetable before they commit to larger contracts.

validation_notes: Citation repaired: quote found in ¶7, not cited ¶6

facts.subject: Ministry forecast
facts.statement: The ministry has not published a forecast for the rest of the year.

source_ref.text_snippet: The ministry has not published a forecast for the rest of the year.
